sn17.2:1.2: Dāruṇo bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya || || 3
sn17.2:1.3: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave baḷisiko āmisagatam baḷisaṃ gambhīre udakarahade pakkhipeyya ||
sn17.2:1.5: Evañhi so bhikkhave maccho gilitabaḷiso bāḷisikassa anayam āpanno vyasanam āpanno yathākāmakaraṇīyo bāḷisikassa || || 4
sn17.2:2.1: Bāḷisiko ti kho bhikkhave Mārassetaṃ pāpimato adhivacanaṃ ||
sn17.2:2.3: Yo hi koci bhikkhave bhikkhu uppannam lābhasakkārasilokam assādeti nikāmeti || ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave bhikkhu gilitabaḷiso Mārassa anayam āpanno vyasanam āpanno yathākāma karaṇīyo pāpimato || || 6
sn17.2:2.4: Evaṃ dāruṇo kho bhikkhave lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya || || 7
sn17.2:2.6: Uppannaṃ lābhasakkārasilokaṃ pajahissama || na ca no uppanno lābhasakkārasiloko cittam pariyādāya ṭhassatīti || || 8
